describe.description: A stout, low-bodied quadruped shown in right-facing profile standing on a small patch of bare ground with sparse dry debris. The body is broad and rounded with a pale, smooth, faintly ridged underbelly and a dorsal surface densely covered in overlapping dark gray-brown scales from the top of the head across the back and sides to the tip of the tail. The head is broad, flat and blunt-snouted with a large round eye on the side, a small nostril, and a pale cream lower jaw and throat. Behind the head on both sides of the neck are several stalked, feathery external gills with fine filaments. Four thick, gray, muscular legs with bent joints support the body, each ending in a broad splayed foot, and a long, thick, tapering tail extends straight back behind the body, scaly above and pale below.

describe.description: The drawing shows a single stout, low-slung quadruped in three-quarter side view facing right, standing on four short thick legs with a long thick tapering tail extending behind. Its back, top of the head, sides, and top of the tail are covered in overlapping dark gray-brown rounded armor-like scales, while its throat, chest, belly, and underside of the tail are smooth pale cream-yellow. The head is broad and flat with a blunt snout, a wide straight mouth line, a small round nostril, and large prominent round eyes. Just behind the head on the neck are branched feathery external gills with central stalks and fine filaments.
